worldcombat.skill.scald.summary: Boils a kettle of water in its palm and hurls it: the scalding water arcs onto the target, dealing special damage and possibly burning, then leaves a still-rolling puddle where it lands. Anyone stepping in is scalded, and standing in it scalds them again and again. Boiling water thaws frozen targets and the user, and hits a target standing in water or rain harder.
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.0: Burn a target from range with a thrown kettle of boiling water
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.1: Leave a scalding puddle that locks down a patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.2: Thaw frozen on the target and on yourself
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.3: Scald an already-wet target for extra damage
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.0: A hit deals about %1$s special damage; the target's special defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.1: The glob arcs out to a range of %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.2: On a hit there is a %1$s chance to leave the target burned: while burning its physical damage is halved and it loses about 6.25%% of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1), lasting about 40 seconds, with Fire types immune; the hit also spreads a %2$s block puddle at the landing point.
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.3: The puddle rolls for %1$s s; an enemy stepping in has a %4$s burn chance, and standing inside takes about %2$s special damage every %3$s s until it dries up.
worldcombat.skill.scald.rule.thaw: A hit thaws the target's frozen; the move can also be used while frozen, clearing the user's own frozen as it winds up.
worldcombat.skill.scald.rule.wet: A target that is in water or rain is scalded worse: hit damage x1.18.
worldcombat.skill.scald.simmer.on: Long-boil: a bigger, longer-lived puddle that scalds more readily with a 3 tick longer wind-up, at the cost of x0.9 direct power and +10 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.scald.simmer.off: Flash-boil: x1.06 direct power and -2 cooldown, with a smaller, shorter puddle that scalds less readily.
worldcombat.skill.scald.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.scald.growth.0: From level %1$s the boil rises to %2$s power and %3$s burn chance.
worldcombat.skill.scald.growth.1: From level %1$s the boil rises to %2$s power, the puddle to %3$s blocks and the slick burn chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.simme: On: a bigger, longer-lived puddle that scalds more readily, but a 3 tick longer wind-up, x0.9 direct power and +10 cooldown, for locking down ground. Off (flash-boil): x1.06 direct power and -2 cooldown, with a small, short puddle that scalds less readily, for picking a target off.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.ai.so: On: targets standing in water or rain rank first for the extra 18% scald damage; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
On: a target with other enemies nearby ranks first so the puddle locks them down too; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
